svg.title: Shortest path through hierarchical routing tiles
svg.desc: A pale green neighborhood map with gray buildings and roads. A black route connects red Start and End pins across green routing tiles and smaller red subdivisions. Four editable layers hold the ground, houses and roads with the route, street names and other text, and prominent green and red tile boundaries above everything.

g.text: Map tiles by Stamen Design, under CC BY 3.0. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
